sonnet.problem: The statement makes two claims. Its first half, that the crowd tells them to be silent, just re-asks the fact card 5 already asked and answered.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: Story card 11 has already said that Jesus touches their eyes. The True statement restates that, so the baker needs no reasoning to answer. It also bundles two claims, the touch and the sight at once.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.
